title: Reading candle types
note: Use the candle body to see the open-to-close move. Long bodies usually show stronger momentum than small bodies.
author: Fund your Future

title: Bullish candlestick idea
note: A hammer or bullish engulfing candle after a pullback can hint at a possible reversal, but always confirm with volume and trend.
author: Fund your Future

title: Bearish candle watch
note: A shooting star or bearish engulfing candle near resistance can warn that momentum may be fading.
author: Fund your Future

title: Doji candles
note: Doji candles often show indecision. They matter most when they appear after a strong move or near a major support or resistance level.
author: Fund your Future

title: Upper wick meaning
note: A long upper wick can mean buyers pushed price up, but sellers stepped in before the close.
author: Fund your Future

title: Track your own progress
note: Post what you learned from your last trade or chart review. A short note like 'I waited for confirmation' helps you improve over time.
author: Fund your Future

title: My trade review template
note: What was my setup? What did I do well? What would I change next time? Use the feed like a personal learning journal.
author: Fund your Future
